captions.detailed: A 1:1 macro prime camera lens consisting of a short, thick outer barrel in a matte black finish, a silver-toned metal mounting ring, and an extending inner focusing barrel. The outer barrel features a rotating aperture ring with white index markings and a ribbed texture. The inner barrel slides telescopically along the central optical axis for focusing, housing a dark glass front element.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a macro camera lens with an outer barrel, a rotating aperture ring, and an inner focusing barrel. The inner barrel should slide telescopically inside the outer barrel, and the aperture ring should rotate continuously around the main axis.
captions.factory: Construct the lens using three main parts. First, model the outer barrel assembly as a cylinder with a silver mount ring. Second, create the aperture ring using a cylinder with small rectangular notches/markers patterned radially, and define a continuous joint about the Z-axis relative to the outer barrel. Third, build the inner focusing barrel as a smaller concentric cylinder with a glass lens face, and establish a prismatic joint along the Z-axis inside the outer barrel.
